verdict.rationale: Digits' own API reference documents an endpoint to "Generate an accounts payable aging report", alongside a bills workflow API and a Bill Pay product, so the core AP aging capability is first-party. The evidence does not show historical as-of-date reporting or per-vendor balance views, and it does not show AP aging in the accountant-facing UI rather than only via the API. Missing for 10: point-in-time/as-of-date AP aging, explicit vendor balance reporting, UI-level AP aging documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see accounts payable aging and vendor balances at any point in time
